title: Lesson 9: Function-Calling Parity Across OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, and Local Models
description: Every frontier provider exposes function calling, but none uses the same wire format. This lesson maps the request and response shapes across OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, and Gemini, then shows why local models (llama.cpp) are the parity wildcard and how one internal schema plus thin per-provider adapters keeps an agent portable.
